chapters.title: Riverglades: pickups and loose ends
chapters.note: Starts where chapter 41 ends: Farholde Keep, hearth bound there. After the 13 Nov recheck no quest here is certain: every leftover Riverglades quest either follows an out quest in Wowhead's series (Biting the Hand, Her World, News to Farholde, The Twilight Threat) or needs a low drop (What We Lost, out). They are written as 'if he offers it' lines on one loop: Powderfuse Port for Friz Frazzlespark's errands (I Know a Guy for Booty Bay and From Port to Port for Feathermoon are plain pickups; Shipping and Handling only if the optional smuggling block of chapter 41 was done), Sunnyglade, Sergeant Riftan at the Twilight's Shroud (30.7,49.1) for Twilight Mementos, Demar Brant and Ashe Amberhall at the Keep for Eye of Mugg and Tome of Twilight. The chapter's sure job is those dungeon pickups. Draft spec: `Claude outputs/40-50-specs-2026-11-13/42-draft.md`.

chapters.title: Krol'dok Stronghold (dungeon)
chapters.note: Required dungeon chapter, one run. Every mob Wowhead lists for it is Elite and none shows a level; the quests are level 41-45, so 'wants 42' is the draft spec's low-confidence call. The chapter opens with the Ironforge training stop (level 42 row) and the Southshore flight to the Dalaran crater for Vengeance of the Highborne (Ranath Nightstride, Alterac 17.8,66.0), hearths back for the run, and hands that quest in at the crater afterwards. Tome of Twilight and Eye of Mugg hang on one boss each. Twilight Mementos (8 bangles at 11%) is grind / luck, and Lingering Essence and Curios of Curiosity follow it in Wowhead's series, so they are conditional; Key Ingredients follows the Krol'dok Moulding that Tunk drops (48%). Eye of Mugg's Bigger Rock on Bigger Stick ties Rage of the Storm and Bonebiter within 1% in the kill-speed model. Draft spec: `43-draft.md`.

chapters.title: Stormwind, the Temple door and Aerie Peak
chapters.note: From Ironforge by tram. Stormwind: Brohann Caskbelly's In Search of The Temple, Mazen's Behest, Vital Supplies; one loop Darkshire - Nethergarde Keep - the Pool of Tears - Nethergarde - Stormwind does the supply run and the Temple door (Mukomonji, a level 62 elite, stands 2.5 units west of the Pool's trigger). Back at Brohann, To The Hinterlands; then Ironforge - Aerie Peak for Falstad, Gryphon Master Talonaxe and Rhapsody Shindigger, whose Kalimdor Kocktail is picked up here for Tanaris and Feralas. Artisan Leatherworking at Drakk Stonehand (skill 200, 5g) and Farseer Maret Firetend's level 42 row fall here. The Twilight Threat and Delivering Closure are handed in at Stormwind only if he has them. The Badlands trip is dropped (Braedyn, 13 Nov). Draft specs to re-cut: `44-draft.md`, `45-draft.md`.

chapters.title: Booty Bay
chapters.note: Aerie Peak - Ironforge - Stormwind - Booty Bay by flight; bind at Booty Bay for this chapter. Friz's caravan chain with Caravaneer Ruzzgot (I Know a Guy, Get the Goods, We've Been Robbed!) and Raptor Mastery's third part at Nesingwary's camp. All's Well That Ends Well and Twice Misplaced Trust are picked up only if offered. The Bloodsail Trunk's position is not in the data. The chapter ends on the Booty Bay - Ratchet boat.

chapters.title: Tanaris I
chapters.note: Gadgetzan and Steamwheedle Port, quest levels 40-46. Gadgetzan's flight point is not known yet: the first trip is by road from Ratchet through the Barrens and the Shimmering Flats (unverified). Bind at Gadgetzan. The Wastewander and Southsea quests, the two WANTED posters, the Screecher Spirits pickup for Feralas, and about 25 Rocs for Rhapsody's three gizzards. Friz's Steamwheedle chain is conditional on the optional smuggling block of chapter 41. Artisan Cooking (Clamlette Surprise at Dirge Quikcleave, Cooking 225) is a gate stop here.

chapters.title: Feralas I
chapters.note: Feathermoon Stronghold, quest levels 41-45. First trip by road: Gadgetzan - Thousand Needles - Thalanaar (flight point) - through Feralas to the Forgotten Coast boat (unverified). The naga and Gordunni quests, the Missing Courier chain, OOX-22/FE, Friz's delivery, the screecher spirits, and the Ironfur bears and Groddoc apes for Rhapsody's livers.

chapters.title: The Hinterlands
chapters.note: Back east: Feathermoon - Thalanaar - Theramore by flight, the Menethil boat, Ironforge for the level 44 training row and the Uldum and Tymor pickups at the Explorers' League, then Aerie Peak. Rhapsody's Kocktail is handed in and Rhapsody's Tale taken; Witherbark Cages and The Altar of Zul lead to Thadius Grimshade (Nethergarde, next chapter but one), which is what opens Nekrum's Medallion for Zul'Farrak. Both Jintha'Alor quests are out: Vile Priestess Hexx and the Ancient Egg's guards are level 51 elites. The ride from Farholde Keep to Powderfuse Port for Friz's hand-ins is only made if he holds those quests. Predicted entry is about a level under the check: the Witherbark and Skulk Rock quests come last.

chapters.title: Searing Gorge
chapters.note: Thorium Point's flight point is not known: the first trip is on foot (which pass is open on Forever is unverified). The board and Thorium Brotherhood quests with normal targets, the Suntara Stones, and Caught! / The Key to Freedom. The Kalaran Windblade chain stops where its targets turn elite. Predicted entry is over a level under the check on quest XP alone: the spec orders the quests by mob level and says what to leave for the return.

chapters.title: Nethergarde and the Cape of Stranglethorn
chapters.note: Ironforge - Stormwind: Rhapsody's Tale to Brohann Caskbelly (Into The Temple of Atal'Hakkar is taken for round 3). Stormwind - Nethergarde Keep: Thadius Grimshade, who gives Nekrum's Medallion for the Zul'Farrak run. Then Booty Bay: The Bloodsail Buccaneers (the captains run to level 48), Stranglethorn Fever (Mokk the Savage, Normal on Wowhead), Cortello's Riddle, Whiskey Slim's Lost Grog and Message in a Bottle, and the Ratchet boat.

chapters.title: Feralas II
chapters.note: Feathermoon by flight now (Ratchet - Theramore - Thalanaar - Feathermoon). Quest levels 46-51: the Writhing Deep, the Sprite Darter chain (it ends in Darnassus, Thousand Needles and the Hinterlands: the spec says how far it goes here), the Feathermoon library errands, the wandering giants, and The Sunken Temple lead-in for Tanaris.

chapters.title: Maraudon (dungeon)
chapters.note: Required dungeon chapter, entered from Desolace (Feathermoon - Nijel's Point flight). Mobs inside are level 43-51 in the DB; the predicted entry is about 46, so the spec decides whether the outer wings are run here and the inner falls later, the way Scarlet Monastery was split, or the whole run waits until after Tanaris II. The Shadowshard Fragments (46%) and the Theradric Crystal Carvings (27%) are collections and are grind / luck.

chapters.title: Tanaris II and Uldum
chapters.note: Gadgetzan by flight (Nijel's Point - Theramore - Gadgetzan). Quest levels 47-51: the silithid chain from Noxious Lair Investigation (five insect parts at 51%, about ten kills), the Dunemaul compound (Gor'marok, Normal on Wowhead), Thistleshrub Valley, the Gahz'ridian ornaments, Tooga, OOX-17/TN, the egg-o-matic, The Stone Circle, the Uldum pedestal, and Screecher Spirits handed in at Steamwheedle Port before the Zul'Farrak run.

chapters.title: Zul'Farrak (dungeon)
chapters.note: Required dungeon chapter, one run from Gadgetzan, moved here from the first Kalimdor trip (Braedyn, 13 Nov) so that Nekrum's Medallion is in the log. Mobs inside are level 43-48 in the DB and every boss is ranked elite there. Seven quests hang on one boss each (Wowhead reads 12-43% over all kills, quest or not) and are labelled normal with a one-kill note. Troll Temper (16% from the trolls) is grind / luck. Gahz'rilla has to be summoned and is optional.

chapters.title: Azshara
chapters.note: Talrendis Point, new on Forever; its flight point is not known, so the first trip is by road from Astranaar (unverified). Quest levels 47-55. Saria Fairmoon's chain (it runs through Lady Sesspira's key, one named mob), the Talrendis and coast quests and Kim'jael are in QuestieDB with Alliance givers. Reclaiming Ravencrest and The Head of the Serpent follow Preserving Eldarath (relics at 14%, out) in Wowhead's series and are conditional; Warlord Krellian is level 55. The two furbolg chains at Ursolan (15 quests) are not in QuestieDB and their Wowhead pages state no side: conditional. Tymor's Arcane Runes and the Dragonscale Leatherworking quest at Peter Galen (37.6,65.4; Leatherworking 225) are done here.

chapters.title: Un'Goro Crater
chapters.note: Marshal's Refuge, reached on foot from Gadgetzan (flight point taken there). The stretch chapter: its quests are level 50-55 and several run to level 54-55 mobs. The pylons, It's a Secret to Everybody, the journal and crate finds and the Lar'korwi quests are placed first; the level 50 pickups come last. If he is under 49 on arrival, the conditional chains in Azshara come first.

chapters.title: Level 50: Ironforge and Nethergarde
chapters.note: Closing stop of the round: the level 46, 48 and 50 training rows not yet bought, the Explorers' League hand-ins for the Uldum and Tymor chains, the tram to Stormwind and the Nethergarde flight to hand Nekrum's Medallion to Thadius Grimshade (The Divination follows; Return to the Hinterlands is left for round 3), the profession ranks still open, and a check with Eldrun for a level-50 class quest (the Classic ones are Horde-side on Wowhead).
